name_reason: Matches data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=chapter, descriptor=init_handler_table; reflects the data type (a table of function pointers). No Ghidra address residue. '_init_' is descriptive, not an address suffix. Both readers index it as the per-chapter init dispatch table.
purpose: Per-chapter init-handler jump table: 30 function pointers, indexed by current_chapter_id (index 0 = chapter 1 .. index 29 = chapter 30), each pointing to that chapter's one-shot init routine invoked when the chapter starts.
logic_summary: Read-only const array of 30 4-byte code pointers in .object2. Callers load EAX = current_chapter_id ([0x53C03]) and CALL dword ptr [EAX*4 + 0x51D71] (cdecl, no args, void return). Invoked at three points: NEW GAME (fd2_main_menu_continue_dispatcher @0x25F10), after a committed CONTINUE save-slot load (same fn @0x260F5), and on each in-game chapter switch (main, game_event_flag==2 branch, after the chapter-end handler). Entries [18][19][20] (chapters 19/20/21) all point to the shared handler fd2_chapter_19_20_21_init_shared @0x33674; entry [0]=fd2_chapter_01_init @0x3231B, [29]=fd2_chapter_30_init @0x33E3C; all others are distinct per-chapter init functions.
element_semantics: Each element is a cdecl, zero-arg, void-returning code pointer = the init handler for chapter (index+1). 27 distinct handlers; chapters 19/20/21 share fd2_chapter_19_20_21_init_shared.
comment_original_issue: Original src comment was accurate but incomplete: it listed only fd2_main_menu_continue_dispatcher as the caller and described the trigger as 'NEW GAME and after a save slot is loaded', omitting the second reader (main) and the in-game chapter-switch trigger.
notes: is_const confirmed: all three xrefs are reads of the table address (READ/DATA), no writers; declared const in src and stored in read-only .object2. Sibling tables in same file: data_fd2_chapter_post_action_handler_table @0x51B19 and data_fd2_chapter_end_handler_table @0x51DE9.
